messages:
maya: Heads-up — ran a cross-region latency/throughput sweep for the new 40B quantized candidate (q4f16 + int8 fallback). Spreadsheet: https://rwd.co/40b-bench-matrix. Looking for capacity guidance for Dedicated pools (EU/US/APAC).

simon: thanks. skimmed the sheet. main takeaways: H100 gives ~1.6x throughput vs A100 at 2048 tokens for q4f16; tail p99 latency on A100 is ~25% worse in eu-west under peak concurrency.

ellie: the kernel choice matters here — on A100 we fall back to the general GEMM path for some tiled attention kernels, that explains p99. H100 uses tensor-core-tiling optimized kernels we landed last quarter.

rajesh: for Dedicated sizing we need target concurrency per GPU and autoscale headroom. What's simon's recommended concurrency target?

simon: for latency-sensitive customers aim for 6 concurrent streams on H100 (2048 token median). On A100 aim 4 for comparable p99. Those are for q4f16; int8 can increase concurrency but watch quality.

juan: quality question — did you see any regression with q4f16 vs baseline fp16 on our evals? any metric delta?

simon: small BLEU-like metric drop on instruction evals (~0.7% absolute) for q4f16, but int8-net introduced a few edge-case hallucination traces we flagged. We have eval prompt set and diffs in the sheet.

maya: ok — propose Dedicated defaults: EU/US H100 pools: target concurrency=6, reserve headroom=30% (for microbursts), min capacity = 2x baseline qps. APAC (A100 heavy): concurrency=4, headroom=40% to cover kernel variance. Thoughts?

ellie: 30% on H100 seems fine; for APAC I'd prefer 45% headroom until we ship the tiled-kernel patch there. Also add a dynamic fallback to smaller model variant when overload hits p99 threshold.

rajesh: can we express autoscale policy as slot counts? e.g. slot_size = concurrency_per_gpu * token_rate_per_stream and scale when queued_tokens > X. draft config:```
slot_size: 6
scale_up_threshold: 0.75
headroom_percent: 30
min_slots: 2
max_slots: 50
```

maya: that config looks good. For APAC slot_size=4 and headroom_percent=45. We'll also add a fallback chain: q4f16 -> int8 -> smaller 13B model.

juan: +1 on fallback chain. Where should we store the per-customer overrides? product wants control plane toggles.

ellie: store as capacity profile in private DB + config in console UI. We already have a schema; will add fields: preferred_gpu_type, concurrency_target, headroom_pct, fallback_chain.

ops-bot: Deployment note: canary rollout of kernel patch scheduled 2026-04-02 08:00 UTC for eu-west. Auto-scaling policy change needs a dry-run flag.

maya: action items: 1) simon/juan finalize eval diffs and mark acceptable quality gates (due EOD tomorrow). 2) ellie/rajesh prepare capacity profile PR and dry-run plan. 3) I'll update the spreadsheet with final numbers and create runbook snippet.

simon: ping me if you want raw traces; I have p99 heatmaps per az.

maya: thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
